guard: The detached supervision warning is bound to the launching systemd invocation and exact false-green unit shape

mutations.name: The detector ignores the systemd invocation identity
mutations.expectRed: a different invocation does not inherit another unit's warning
mutations.cell: a different invocation does not inherit another unit's warning

mutations.name: The detector warns only for Type=oneshot, so a long-running service type is silent
mutations.find: const shape = unit.Type === "oneshot" && unit.RemainAfterExit === "yes" ? " is Type=oneshot with RemainAfterExit=yes and" : "";
mutations.replace:
if (unit.Type !== "oneshot") return undefined;
  const shape = unit.Type === "oneshot" && unit.RemainAfterExit === "yes" ? " is Type=oneshot with RemainAfterExit=yes and" : "";
mutations.expectRed: a Type=simple unit whose main process is background up warns
mutations.cell: a Type=simple unit whose main process is background up warns
mutations.note: The detector now warns for every .service unit whose main process is the launcher, and Type only decides whether the warning names the oneshot shape. This mutant puts a Type test back in front of the warning, so a Type=simple unit is silent again.

mutations.name: The detector misreads RemainAfterExit, so a oneshot unit that remains after exit does not name its shape
mutations.find: const shape = unit.Type === "oneshot" && unit.RemainAfterExit === "yes" ? " is Type=oneshot with RemainAfterExit=yes and" : "";
mutations.replace: const shape = unit.Type === "oneshot" && unit.RemainAfterExit !== "yes" ? " is Type=oneshot with RemainAfterExit=yes and" : "";
mutations.expectRed: a oneshot RemainAfterExit unit names its shape
mutations.cell: a oneshot RemainAfterExit unit names its shape
mutations.note: RemainAfterExit only decides, with Type, whether the warning names the oneshot shape. This mutant inverts that test, so a oneshot unit with RemainAfterExit=yes gets the warning without its shape.
